notes: PiPNN build time is entire builder process including graph serialization; HNSW ready time includes fbin loading and build but no serialization.
Only effort settings meeting recall in every observed repeat at that setting qualify; observation counts are reported, with no interpolation.
RSS is loaded index process residency, not allocator-owned index bytes. Peak is build process memory, including input buffers.
Two repeats describe an observed range; they are not a confidence interval.
